premises.text: People often struggle to make connections in crowded venues.
premises.evidence_span: you've come to an amazing conference like TechCrunch Disrupt, full of brilliant and beautiful people, only to stand by the conference bar eating peanuts, wondering who you should talk to next.

premises.text: Sonar can uncover hidden connections between people in the same venue.
premises.evidence_span: Sonar is a mobile application that uncovers the hidden connections that you share with everyone else in this room.

premises.text: Sonar aggregates publicly available profile data to show relevant connections.
premises.evidence_span: Sonar scours the web for people at this venue, then aggregates and synthesizes publicly available profile data.

premises.text: Sonar provides personalized overviews of connections to facilitate introductions.
premises.evidence_span: Sonar gives me an instant overview of Fergus and how we're connected.

premises.text: Sonar enables hyper-targeted introductions with minimal effort.
premises.evidence_span: you're never more than one click away from a hyper-targeted introduction to the person you want to meet.

premises.text: Sonar aims to democratize in-person connections and local self-expression.
premises.evidence_span: our goal is to democratize the meat space.

value.text: Sonar helps people connect meaningfully in crowded environments.
value.evidence_span: to connect with the person sitting next to us.

notes: No traction metrics or external validation included.
